title: Claims Charged against a KestrelCare Cancellation Refund
content:
**Rule.** The claims charged against a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts pro rata refund are counted as follows: where the plan deducts claims and rental, towing or trip interruption reimbursements have been paid on the plan, the charge is the claim payments net of payments recovered, plus the approved authorizations not yet matched by claim payments (the approved amounts less the claim payments, never below zero), plus those reimbursements; where the plan deducts claims and no such reimbursement has been paid, the charge is the claim payments net of payments recovered plus the approved authorizations not yet matched by claim payments; a plan that does not deduct claims is charged nothing.

## Which plans deduct claims

KestrelCare Powertrain, KestrelCare Powertrain Plus, KestrelCare Silver and KestrelCare Gold deduct claims; KestrelCare Platinum and KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary do not.

## Amounts read from the plan's history

| Amount | Entries totalled over the life of the plan |
|---|---|
| Claim payments | claim payment entries |
| Payments recovered | payment recovery entries |
| Approved amounts | claim decision entries with decision approved |
| Reimbursements | rental car, towing and trip interruption reimbursement entries |

## Figures (hypothetical KestrelCare Gold plan)

Approved amounts 4200.00, claim payments 3000.00, payments recovered 200.00, reimbursements 160.00.

- Charge with the reimbursements: 3000.00 less 200.00, plus 1200.00 (4200.00 less 3000.00), plus 160.00, gives 4160.00.
- The same plan with no reimbursement paid: 4000.00.
- The same history on a KestrelCare Platinum plan: nothing is charged.
- Where claim payments exceed the approved amounts, the unmatched part counts as zero.
